title: Replace Cad Placeholder References with Concrete Forest PNG
description: Replace the CAD play default world references that use placeholder infinite-fixture files (sketch.png, site.pdf) with the actual concrete-forest-reference.png from cad/fixture. This requires adding a cadFixtureVitePlugin to serve cad/fixture at /cad-fixture/ and updating CAD_PLAY_DEFAULT_WORLD_REFERENCES in cad/js/renderer/play/index.tsx.
